description.en: The menu's edit journal = point-in-time recovery for the catalogue KV image (W-PITR, R-BEBOPDB D.1 #11). Every catalogue write that lands (hubstore::with_catalog, seed_catalog, and the bulk import in the venue object's own turn) appends one record per changed key to the append image `catalog.edits` (LogImage kind `catalog.edit`): {v:1, at, by (staff/owner id, never a customer), key, old (sha256 of the replaced value or null), new (value or null = removed), mark (on the last record of a write: a fingerprint of the whole catalogue after it)}. Replay checks every record's `old` against the state so far, so a missing or edited record stops it by name. Replay to time T rebuilds the catalogue of T, byte-equal in its COMPACTED form. A write whose `before` does not match the journal's mark first records the difference as by='?' (unseen). Past 600 records the journal folds to a baseline plus the newest 300. GET lists the newest edits; POST restores one dish to what it held just before an edit (removing it if that edit created it), itself journaled. The console's Menu screen has a history button ('Історія змін меню').
description.uk: Кожна зміна меню записується в журнал catalog.edits (хто, коли, ключ, хеш старого значення, нове значення); відтворення до моменту T дає меню того моменту байт-у-байт; власник бачить історію і може повернути страву як було до зміни.

producer.what: journal (mark check, unseen diff, the write's diff, compaction)
decode (the kind's decoder, before any writer)
before (what a key held just before an edit)
with_catalog journals after the write landed
seed_catalog journals the born venue from nothing
journal_turn: the bulk import journals in the object's turn

consumer.what: openHistory: the sheet, the restore confirm
the restore drill replays the journal against the copy's catalogue

on_disk_format: LogImage (append, chained, crc) image `catalog.edits`; records kind `catalog.edit` v1 (crates/dowiz-hub/src/catalog/edits.rs header). Included in the nightly backup bundle (hubstore::IMAGES).
